notes.title: Full Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Dear Trap Masters

CD2: Trap Master will be releasing full verison on Friday March 28！We've cooked up tons of new content so stay tuned!

🙏Add the game to your wishlist and get notified at the time of full release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2330870/CD_2_Trap_Master/

💸Pricing
The full version will be the same price as the Early Access version - 20% OFF upon full release so don't miss it!

📖Unlock [The Book of Tengu], Master the Deck of Elements
Matering the majestic energies of the earth and the mysterious magic of the Dragon, a new power has emerged in the realm of illusions with their exceptional shamanic skills.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43711502/6dc4deaef077f05643e7590c3c7a9843bfaa98ac.png

Change the tide of battle in your own unique way. Summon an assortment of natural elemental totems and place them on the field to boost traps with powerful energy. These mysterious totems carry the power of the natural elements such as earth, lightning, ice, and demons - do not underestimate its power.

Furthermore, by sacrificing these totems, you can gain access to the transformative power of the forces of nature. Unleash the fury of the earth to crack mountains; turn snow into ice to block your enemies. The versatility of this ability makes you an unpredictable, inescapable threat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43711502/c5f3fe3fdfdc511011aba701e48e943b69c3ef9e.png

🎲Crossover with Die in the Dungeon 
More details will be unveiled upon release! 

🚀Balance Adjustment & VFX Upgrades
We have fine tuned the balance of monsters, cards and items to create a fair challenge for players of all levels. New visual effects for all map nodes and some card effects have been added to enhance your gamplay experience! 

See you on March 28!
ACE

notes.title: Five Mighty Bosses Update!
notes.notes:
Dear Trap Masters,

👋It's been a while and we're back with a bunch of new content! The game is also 20% OFF to celebrate the lunar new year! (Discount will start at 10am Feb 6 PT)


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2330870/CD_2_Trap_Master/

👋Five Mighty Bosses Updated

 1️⃣ Super Jelly Man: He will split into multiples! 
Skill 1 - Splits into 2 and shrinks each time it is half-blooded, up to 3 times.
Skill 2 - Adds 1 [Poisoned Jelly] to the discard pile and takes 2 points of damage when discarded.
 2️⃣ Racing Horse Fei Fei: The more the merrier!
Skill - Summon 2 Horse Fei Fei to his side
 3️⃣ Golden Giant: It's raining gold!
Skill 1 - Dropping 1 gold coin when attacked
Skill 2 - Releasing the Goldize spell stops movement for 5 seconds. Add cards to hand (Greedy Gold [Cursed Card] - Expendable, -25 gold when discarded)
 4️⃣ Reaper: Death is his best friend.
Skill 1 - Upon death, it turns into a relic and rests on the field, resurrecting in place after 20 seconds without returning to the stage.
Skill 2 - For each unit around you that dies, life increases by 10 and size increases by 1%
 5️⃣ Giant Beast: Size matters.Skill - Each time you redraw, 20% of your lifesteal is restored


🐉New character Available in Test Branch
Unfold the book of the dragon, and wield new traps to crush enemies!
We added over 30 new cards to enrich your build, and a new Totem property that could create powerful synergies in these new cards.

Test Branch code:
AceCD2PreTest
*The new character is still in testing - please let us know if you have any feedback or run into any issues! (Find us on Discord)

🐛We also fixed bugs that led to game crashes or empty deck.

💗Have fun gaming & Happy lunar new year!
ACE

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello trap masters! 

After a period of hard work, we're happy to report that a new update is now live!

We've made a number of optimisations and added new features to the game, here are the details of the update:


 1. Treasure System: Holding treasure will not only increase your combat power, but will also add a lot of fun to your adventures.
 2. Card Interaction Optimisation: We have optimised the interaction of using cards to make the experience smoother.
 3. Map node generation algorithm optimisation: This update has adjusted the map node generation algorithm, so that the distribution of different types of events on the map will be more reasonable.
 4. Homescreen update: We moved the homescreen to a brand new scene, and we believe you will like this new experience.
 5. BUG FIX: We have fixed some previously existing bugs to ensure the game flow can go more smoothly.


🔴Important Note🔴
For players who already have a gamesave, we recommend that you click Start New Game. If you choose to continue the game, it may result in a poor gaming experience due to issues with the map. In this case, it is still recommended that you restart a new game for the best gaming experience (previously acquired demon cards are unaffected and can still be used normally)

Thank you for your support and understanding, and we hope you enjoy this update. We will continue to work hard to bring you more quality content!

Last but not least, have a great weekend!
Free prologue will be available soon, follow and add wishlist to be the first to experience it!
